words: Task 46 will surpass even the tarazu point 'video kaisi ho' level on its full completion, implementing things required.
90 se 99 percent videos L3 ya isse upar ke level ki ho.
Content decides the scene plan; the scene plan decides which visual level the video code is made at. BIE itself must be capable up to L5a.

about: The visual level ladder (Task 046, docs/vision/VISUAL_LEVELS.md). Every shot of a scene plan carries a level from shot_levels; the director chooses the level the content demands, starting from the capability's default_level in bie/toolbox/capabilities.json. The code check per video: the shot-seconds at minimum_share.at_or_above or higher are at least minimum_share.share of the video; a video below that is not rendered. This file carries no rules; it is data the director and the checks read.
chain: content → scene plan (one shot per spoken sentence, each with a level) → video code made at that level

levels.name: teacher at a board
levels.means: a person explaining at a board, as in a classroom recording
levels.use: never a BIE output; only for learning how teachers explain (the teacher example bank)

levels.name: clean 2D
levels.means: vector diagrams, draw-on line art, equation cards, slides
levels.use: where a flat drawing is the clearest picture: a vector problem, a circuit, a case card, a definition slide
examples: a vector problem drawn with arrows

levels.name: rich 2D / 2.5D
levels.means: motion graphics, illustrated stills, light 3D, timelines, lit boards, kinetic captions
levels.use: the floor for most teaching shots: equation steps on a lit board, a graph that draws itself, a timeline with nodes, a board that fills, a mnemonic card, a split comparison
examples: equation steps on a lit board

levels.name: stylized 3D
levels.means: one 3D world per topic; the camera moves between its parts; cutaway and exploded views; a process shown with flow
levels.use: engineering, physics apparatus, the earth, machines, orbits
examples: a machine part exploded into its pieces
the earth cut open to its layers
an orbit with the planet moving

levels.name: photoreal micro or machine 3D
levels.means: lighting, depth of field, focus glow, particle motion; cells, molecules, chips, organs
levels.use: the epithelium benchmark level: a lit sheet of cells, particles crossing it, a zoom from the organ to the sheet
examples: a sheet of squamous cells with the top cell glowing
oxygen particles crossing the thin sheet

levels.name: photoreal humans, landscapes, Pixar-grade character acting
levels.means: photoreal people and places, feature-film character animation
levels.use: not made by code; outside BIE's output. A scene plan that asks for L5b is a planning error and fails the check

default_by_kind.note: fallbacks the director uses when a capability has no default_level (it should not happen: every capability names one)
